Upstream repository: https://github.com/n3slami/Diva
Vendored commit: d0f85b25a90e00e3aeff4391e2f280d11cacb2af

This directory contains the minimal subset of the upstream Diva repository
needed to build the integer-optimized benchmark adapter on Linux x86_64 and
AArch64 platforms.

Local portability changes: guard x86 headers; preserve zero semantics in
leading/trailing-zero helpers; use compiler byte swaps; add SVE2 BDEP select;
handle a missing parent /proc entry. x86 BMI2 selection is retained. ARM
portable builds use the upstream broadword select and Wormhole NEON/CRC code.
The SVE2 executable is selected only after checking Linux hardware capabilities.
No filter layout, bulk-loading algorithm, load factor or hash seed is changed.
An additional boundary-case fix skips the empty bulk-load tail for 1024*k+1
keys (including a singleton); upstream otherwise compares equal boundaries
forever. The ordinary bulk-load and probe paths retain their algorithms.
